title: Insights into the adsorption-assisted PMS activation of Ce-UiO-66-4F in an in situ chemical oxidation process for efficient pollutant removal
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00126A, Paper
Dong Wang, Soliu O. Ganiyu, Xuefen Wang, Mohamed Gamal El-Din
In this study, a Ce-UiO-66-4F catalyst with an enhanced in situ chemical oxidation (ISCO) process was constructed using tetrafluoroterephthalic acid and Ce(IV) for the degradation of pollutants with electron-donating groups.
